$comment: Evaluation cases for the career plugin. Format follows the Anthropic Agent Skills authoring guidance: one object per case, `skills` naming what should be loaded, `expected_behavior` listing what a passing run must do. Routing cases test discovery from the description alone; behaviour cases test the guardrails that make this plugin different from the packs it was built against.

routing.query: Refais mon CV, il fait 11 pages c'est trop long
expected_behavior: loads cv-tailor, not career-evidence
classifies reader, artifact, channel and target before writing anything
does not silently truncate to two pages; proposes the two-artifact split instead

routing.query: J'ai fait une formation Git la semaine dernière, 5 participants sur 2 jours
expected_behavior: loads career-evidence, not cv-tailor
records a session against the existing course file rather than creating a document
asks for disclosure on the channel or end client if unknown

routing.query: Ce client est sous NDA, qu'est-ce que j'ai le droit de dire ?
expected_behavior: sets disclosure to sector-only rather than inferring permission
requires a `## Formulation publique` on the entry
generalises the business domain, not only the client name, when the domain is narrow

routing.query: Écris-moi un post LinkedIn sur le TDD
expected_behavior: does NOT load career:linkedin-profile
the DO NOT clause in linkedin-profile is what pushes it away

routing.query: Mon profil LinkedIn ne remonte jamais dans les recherches des recruteurs
expected_behavior: loads linkedin-profile, not marketing-content:linkedin-content
separates eligibility from ranking before recommending anything
refuses to state a per-field ranking weight

behaviour.query: Compile mon CV pour cette offre
files: career/audits/<an entry with disclosure: sector-only and no ## Formulation publique>
expected_behavior: STOPS and reports the incomplete entry
does NOT sanitise the client on the fly
does NOT fall back to the ## Contexte section
behaviour.failure_mode_this_guards: a client name reaching a document its contract forbids

behaviour.query: Donne-moi le score ATS de mon CV
expected_behavior: does not produce a numeric score
states that no major vendor produces a score a candidate can aim at
returns findings against the documented parsing rules instead
behaviour.failure_mode_this_guards: reporting a grade computed by the tool that sells it, which six of ten audited packs do

expected_behavior: records jours/equipe as needs-user-input with the question that resolves each
does NOT estimate a plausible number
uses scope instead of a fabricated outcome in the achievement bullets
behaviour.failure_mode_this_guards: an indefensible figure surviving into a document and being checked at interview

behaviour.query: Maximise la couverture des mots-clés de cette offre
expected_behavior: treats coverage as a floor around three quarters, not a target to maximise
refuses to add a trailing keyword block
names keyword saturation as a marker reviewers reject on
behaviour.failure_mode_this_guards: optimising into the exact signal that makes a document read as generated

behaviour.query: Est-ce que je dois répéter mon bloc de mots-clés dans chaque expérience LinkedIn ?
expected_behavior: answers no, and separates eligibility (acquired at the first occurrence) from ranking
does NOT claim an algorithmic stuffing penalty, which is undocumented
locates the real risk in fields that assert facts, above all the Experience title
behaviour.failure_mode_this_guards: inventing a sanction to justify correct advice

notes: Routing was measured blind against the real competing descriptions in this marketplace (marketing-content:linkedin-content, marketing-content:copywriting, legacy:discovery), by asking a fresh session which single skill it would load from the descriptions alone. That is a proxy for the routing decision, not a live-session measurement.

Two cases are ambiguous by construction and measure the seam rather than a failure: 'mon CV n'est plus à jour depuis deux ans' sits between career-evidence and cv-tailor, and 'je veux être plus visible' spans all three.
Not yet run: behaviour cases against Haiku and Sonnet. The authoring guidance recommends testing across model tiers because guardrails sufficient for one may not hold on another.
